beats.say: A free kiss beats a priced truffle.
A free Kiss appears. Sounds generous.
But it stops comparison - the free trick.
When the Kiss costs zero, 69% pick it.
Even though the truffle is only 14 ¢ cheaper, only 31% stay.
Zero price erases the reference point, so buyers ignore the gap.
A café offers a regular latte for $3, a flavored latte for $3.50, and a free small espresso.
The free espresso feels like a bonus, so the $3 latte becomes the smart pick.
If something is free, expect it to dominate. Follow for more.
